mission_instrument: ISS long-duration missions before 2012; seven astronauts whose case data NASA approved for release

units.lp_day_after_return: d after return to Earth (day count as printed)

preprocessing: Transcribed by hand from the case narratives in section IV.A. Table 1 of the report is an image and was not used. Onset values keep the printed unit and are not converted to days. Postflight findings are short summaries; the verbatim column quotes the onset sentence.
license_terms: NASA publication approved for public release (12 July 2012), public domain in the United States
provenance: REPLAY. Case descriptions printed in a NASA evidence report; not measurements recorded by a device.
is_not: Not OCT, IOP or imaging data. Not a random sample: these are the cases NASA had approved for release.

consumers.use: Routine vision check: the in-flight report of a vision change is the trigger
Eval scenarios, including two cases with no in-flight symptom
Onboard plan for a vision change (spare reading glasses were delivered in case 4 and 5)
